# Security reporting

Please report suspected vulnerabilities through [GitHub private vulnerability reporting](https://github.com/moztopia/moztopia-access/security/advisories/new) when available. If private reporting is unavailable, open a minimal issue requesting a private contact channel without exploit details, secrets or personal data. A dedicated response address and response-time commitment have not been established.

This unreleased package has no published supported release line yet. Review the wiki's testing and compatibility record before evaluation. Never disclose a consuming application's data in a public issue.
